title: Rule 05 — Learn noun phrases as chunks
short: A few case distinctions are unavoidable; avoid full declension by memorizing complete useful phrases.
syntax:
der Termin → einen Termin (object)
die Frage → eine Frage (object)
das Ticket → ein Ticket (object)
body: German nouns have grammatical gender. For a direct object, masculine der/ein changes to den/einen; feminine and neuter articles generally keep their familiar nominative form. Store “einen Termin”, “eine Frage”, “ein Ticket” as if each were one dictionary entry.
pitfall: Incorrect: Ich brauche ein Termin. Correct: Ich brauche einen Termin.
